name: smwmusic-pok-mon-black-white-accumula-town-sad-remix
title: Pokémon Black/White - Accumula Town (Sad Remix)
description: This is the Accumula Town music, but slowed down by 60%, with some change in instrumentation, making it sound more mellow or melancholy. Probably fits best on cutscenes, or this theme could vibe well for nighttime areas. Can be paired with this song to allow this theme to reoccur during parts of your hack if wanted.
